verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs say an individual API key can be locked to specific endpoints and output formats, enforced server-side so a request cannot override it. Team API keys can also be restricted to IP/CIDR allowlists, which together cover least-privilege credential scoping for an agent. Missing for 10: detailed docs on issuing multiple keys per agent (creation, rotation, expiry), agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond short doc snippets.
